experiment: group recency in first prize, testing recent and overdue directions globally and at the same target hour

methodology.gapDefinition: number of eligible first-prize draws since the most recent occurrence; zero means the group appeared in the latest eligible draw
methodology.unseenGroupGap: equal to the number of eligible historical draws
methodology.tieTreatment: average rank and fractional credit at Top-K cutoff
methodology.temporalValidation: first 500 evaluated cases versus last 500 evaluated cases
